mapper.update: CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE capacity_number (n INT PRIMARY KEY)
CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE capacity_item LIKE capacity_number
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO app_user (id, username, username_normalized, password_hash, display_name) SELECT CONCAT(#{values.prefix}, 'user_', n), CONCAT(#{values.prefix}, 'user_', n), CONCAT(#{values.prefix}, 'user_', n), #{values.password}, CONCAT('容量成员', n) FROM capacity_number WHERE n <= 99
INSERT INTO user_preference (user_id) SELECT CONCAT(#{values.prefix}, 'user_', n) FROM capacity_number WHERE n <= 99

INSERT INTO enterprise_member (enterprise_id, user_id, display_name, joined_at, updated_at) SELECT #{values.enterprise}, CONCAT(#{values.prefix}, 'user_', n), CONCAT('容量成员', n), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) FROM capacity_number WHERE n <= 99

INSERT INTO sys_user_role (enterprise_id, user_id, role_id, created_at) SELECT #{values.enterprise}, CONCAT(#{values.prefix}, 'user_', n), #{values.role}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) FROM capacity_number WHERE n <= 99

INSERT INTO resource (id, enterprise_id, kind, name, subtype, description, owner_user_id, next_version_no) SELECT CONCAT(#{values.prefix}, 'agent_', n), #{values.enterprise}, 'agent', CONCAT('容量员工', n), 'chat', '由测试程序生成的员工介绍', #{values.admin}, 2 FROM capacity_number WHERE n BETWEEN #{values.first} AND 999

INSERT INTO resource_draft (enterprise_id, resource_id, config_json, config_hash, updated_by) SELECT #{values.enterprise}, CONCAT(#{values.prefix}, 'agent_', n), #{values.config}, #{values.hash}, #{values.admin} FROM capacity_number WHERE n BETWEEN #{values.first} AND 999

INSERT INTO resource_version (id, enterprise_id, resource_id, version_no, name, description, config_json, config_hash, release_note, published_by, published_at) SELECT CONCAT(#{values.prefix}, 'version_', n), #{values.enterprise}, CONCAT(#{values.prefix}, 'agent_', n), 1, CONCAT('容量员工', n), '由测试程序生成的员工介绍', #{values.config}, #{values.hash}, '容量验收', #{values.admin}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) FROM capacity_number WHERE n BETWEEN #{values.first} AND 999
mapper.update: UPDATE resource SET published_version_id = CONCAT(#{values.prefix}, 'version_', SUBSTRING_INDEX(id, '_', -1)) WHERE enterprise_id = #{values.enterprise} AND id LIKE CONCAT(#{values.prefix}, 'agent_%')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_listing (enterprise_id, agent_id, listed, hire_policy, updated_by, created_at, updated_at) SELECT #{values.enterprise}, CONCAT(#{values.prefix}, 'agent_', n), TRUE, 'automatic', #{values.admin}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) FROM capacity_number WHERE n BETWEEN #{values.first} AND 999

INSERT INTO agent_hire (id, enterprise_id, user_id, agent_id, hired_at, last_used_at) SELECT CONCAT(#{values.prefix}, 'hire_', n), #{values.enterprise}, CONCAT(#{values.prefix}, 'user_', n), #{values.agent}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) FROM capacity_number WHERE n <= 99

INSERT INTO agent_hire (id, enterprise_id, user_id, agent_id, hired_at, last_used_at) SELECT CONCAT(#{values.prefix}, 'hire_admin'), #{values.enterprise}, #{values.admin}, #{values.agent}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM agent_hire WHERE enterprise_id = #{values.enterprise} AND user_id = #{values.admin} AND agent_id = #{values.agent})

INSERT INTO resource_grant (id, enterprise_id, resource_id, subject_type, subject_id, capability, created_by, created_at) SELECT UUID(), #{values.enterprise}, id, 'enterprise', #{values.enterprise}, #{values.capability}, #{values.admin}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) FROM resource WHERE enterprise_id = #{values.enterprise}

INSERT INTO agent_conversation (id, enterprise_id, user_id, agent_id, agent_version_id, hire_id, title, created_at, updated_at) SELECT CONCAT(#{values.prefix}, 'conversation_', person.n, '_', item.n), #{values.enterprise}, IF(person.n = 100, #{values.admin}, CONCAT(#{values.prefix}, 'user_', person.n)), #{values.agent}, #{values.version}, h.id, CONCAT('容量历史对话', item.n), TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, -item.n, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)), TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, -item.n, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) FROM capacity_number person CROSS JOIN capacity_item item JOIN agent_hire h ON h.enterprise_id = #{values.enterprise} AND h.user_id = IF(person.n = 100, #{values.admin}, CONCAT(#{values.prefix}, 'user_', person.n)) AND h.agent_id = #{values.agent} WHERE person.n <= 100

INSERT INTO agent_message (id, enterprise_id, conversation_id, role, content, status, blocks_json, context_json, created_at, updated_at) SELECT CONCAT(#{values.messageRole}, '_', id), enterprise_id, id, #{values.messageRole}, '这是一条由容量验收程序生成的历史消息。', 'completed', JSON_ARRAY(), JSON_ARRAY(), created_at, updated_at FROM agent_conversation WHERE enterprise_id = #{values.enterprise}

INSERT INTO knowledge_document (id, enterprise_id, resource_id, name, file_id, active_file_id, active_generation, last_generation, status, chunk_count, processed_at) SELECT CONCAT(#{values.prefix}, 'document_', n), #{values.enterprise}, CONCAT(#{values.prefix}, 'knowledge'), CONCAT('容量资料', n, '.txt'), CONCAT(#{values.prefix}, 'file_', n), CONCAT(#{values.prefix}, 'file_', n), 1, 1, 'ready', 1000, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) FROM capacity_number WHERE n <= 100

INSERT INTO knowledge_chunk (id, enterprise_id, document_id, file_id, generation, ordinal, locator_json, content_text, content_hash, created_at, search_terms) SELECT CONCAT(#{values.prefix}, 'chunk_', document.n, '_', item.n), #{values.enterprise}, CONCAT(#{values.prefix}, 'document_', document.n), CONCAT(#{values.prefix}, 'file_', document.n), 1, item.n, JSON_OBJECT('section', CONCAT('第', item.n, '段')), #{values.text}, SHA2(#{values.text}, 256), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), #{values.terms} FROM capacity_number document CROSS JOIN capacity_item item WHERE document.n <= 100
mapper.select: SELECT MIN(total) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM agent_conversation WHERE enterprise_id = #{enterprise} GROUP BY user_id) counts
